items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Roberta Heiseck by the interviewee (Paul L. Howard). The name appears only in the interviewer's turn.

ctx.x: Now, who was singing there? Can you mention their names?
I said, Roberta Heiseck and myself, or the both of us. We were there, they were playing at Vernon Country Club.
